attempt1: Propose the full past-due amount (or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on the last business day of this week, or of next week if today is that day, capped at the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Before identity is verified do not say arrears, debt, payment, overdue or the product, to anyone including relatives and colleagues.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not say "arrears", "debt", "payment", "overdue" or the product before identity is verified.

extra_rules.statement: Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirms identity; Hello, go ahead, who is this do not. Answer a customer question first; the ask that follows is the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

extra_rules.statement: If someone else answers, say nothing beyond the opening sentence and do not say why you call; only ask when the customer can be reached. Nobody but the customer may answer security questions or be told about the account, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.

extra_rules.statement: Callback window is today or next business day, 10:00 to 20:00 inclusive, and later than now. If the offered time is outside, ask once more; if again outside, do not schedule and close not_reached/no_callback.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If that is also outside it, do not schedule.

extra_rules.statement: Send date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD; numeric-only dates are read day, month, year; postcode in capitals with one space before the last three characters; phone as four digits.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

extra_rules.statement: A day_month_swapped hint retry does not count as a wrong answer; ask the customer to say the month as a word.
extra_rules.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

extra_rules.statement: After two wrong answers do not state the debt; tell the customer to call the number on their statement or visit a branch.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After two wrong answers, do not state the debt.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer declines to answer, explain once that the questions protect the account; asking what the call is about counts as declining; a second refusal or second such question closes not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining.

extra_rules.statement: Call get_account only after all security questions pass; name the product in words and state past_due and days_late.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After every question passes, call `get_account`.

extra_rules.statement: Promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. If the customer names a weekend or holiday not after the deadline, offer the next business day; if after the deadline, say the latest recordable date is the deadline and offer it; refusal of the deadline is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Vague date: ask once for the exact day, then propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Never ask how much the customer can pay; the agent proposes every amount. Ask the full amount first. If the full amount is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue; refusal is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?".

extra_rules.statement: A customer amount from floor to full inclusive is accepted; below the floor say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once; if not accepted, flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.

extra_rules.statement: A date or amount the customer proposes is never a refusal. A flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt; a no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal. Do not repeat an offer already refused; when attempts are used up close no_promise/refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.

extra_rules.statement: On illness, death in the family or job loss: one short sympathy sentence, no persuasion attempt, offer the support team; accept -> transfer welfare and close transferred/support; decline -> no_promise/hardship. If the customer still names a date or amount, record the promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: Read product, amount and date back and ask Do you confirm?; call create_promise only after a clear yes. If the customer changes date or amount, recheck and read back again.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes

extra_rules.statement: One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call. Say it is recorded only after create_promise returns ok true; on failure retry once, then say it could not be recorded and close no_promise/service_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: One promise per product.

extra_rules.statement: I already paid: say payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, close as paid.
extra_rules.brief_quote: "I already paid": say that payments can take one business day to appear

extra_rules.statement: Dispute (not mine, never had product, closed or paid off in the past): do not argue, no promise, close no_promise/dispute.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise

extra_rules.statement: Request for a new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan; transfer to restructuring and close transferred/restructuring.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

extra_rules.statement: Request for a human: ask once whether you can help first; if they insist transfer to queue agent and close transferred/human, before and after verification.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once whether you can help first

extra_rules.statement: Question not answerable from the tools: say you do not have that information; do not invent figures, dates or reasons.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer says twice they do not want to talk, close no_promise/refused; before verification close not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer says twice that they do not want to talk

extra_rules.statement: Exactly one close_call, last tool call, after thanking and saying goodbye. If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.

extra_rules.statement: Brief does not state a product id format.
A vague date has no exact day. Ask once for the day. If there is still none, offer the deadline from the facts.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.

extra_rules.statement: The customer asks for a new payment plan, a restructuring, or lower instalments. A near-miss is not this intent.
extra_rules.brief_quote: The **floor** is `minimum_payment` for a credit card, and `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan.
examples: The **floor** is `minimum_payment` for a credit card, and `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan.
Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.
If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once.

extra_rules.statement: The customer asks to speak to a person. A near-miss is not this intent.
extra_rules.brief_quote: The agent finds the customer, checks identity, states the debt, gets a payment promise where it can, and closes the call with the correct outcome.
examples: The agent finds the customer, checks identity, states the debt, gets a payment promise where it can, and closes the call with the correct outcome.
If the customer asks whether you are a robot or an AI, say that you are Ostral Bank's automated assistant and continue.

extra_rules.statement: The customer names a hardship such as illness, a death in the family, or job loss.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.
examples: If the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt.
